newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN SHIPPING COMPANIES CARRY LESS CARGOES.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN SHIPPING COMPANIES CARRY LESS CARGOES.

text.p: Lithuanian shipping companies carried 13.2 percent less cargoes in the first quarter of 1997 compared to the same period last year, the country's statistics department said on Thursday.
The department said in a statement that the volume of goods carried by Lithuania's shipping companies amounted to 1.07 million tonnes during the first three months of the year.

It also said that the volume of goods transported from the port of Klaipeda by Lithuanian shipping companies was 111,900 tonnes in the first quarter of 1997, a sharp fall of 38.9 percent compared to the same period last year.

The statement said that the volume of cargo transported by Lithuania's shipping companies to Klaipeda amounted to 160,800 tonnes in the first quarter, a 27.3 percent decline versus the same period in 1996.

Lithuanian shipping companies transported 792,900 tonnes of cargoes between foreign ports in the first quarter of 1997, a decrease of 3.7 percent compared to the same period in 1996, the statement said.
